description:
The map is large, but please stay within the boundaries.（Since not enough references have been added at the moment, you might think that the player isn't moving, but that's not really the case）
Use WASD to move, use left-click to change the blade rotation direction.
You can destroy an enemy by touching it with your blade, and the game is over if you are touched by an enemy's blade.
Eating pink pills will randomly increase your movement speed or blade rotation speed (except when the blade touches the pill and destroy it).
Two difficulty levels have now been added: easy and hard. Easy mode requires only 5 enemies to defeat to succeed, hard mode requires twice as many.
Also the blades move at different speeds for different difficulties.
One enemy will be generated every 5 seconds, and one pill will be generated every 30 seconds.
